request.text:
<Elderly goblin matriarch: low female contralto, husky dry rasp and age-creak; measured, wary, quietly commanding, with tired warmth. Mood: idle.> Valley people. Say what you came to say, or go back down the hill.
<long pause>
<Elderly goblin matriarch: low female contralto, husky dry rasp and age-creak; measured, wary, quietly commanding, with tired warmth. Mood: idle.> You came back up the hill. Not many valley people do that twice.
<long pause>
<Elderly goblin matriarch: low female contralto, husky dry rasp and age-creak; measured, wary, quietly commanding, with tired warmth. Mood: idle.> Fed. For now. The little ones have stopped crying in the night. That is a sound I had forgotten.
<long pause>
<Elderly goblin matriarch: low female contralto, husky dry rasp and age-creak; measured, wary, quietly commanding, with tired warmth. Mood: idle.> With my grandson. Vorga thinks a bargain is a defeat. He took the angriest of our young and went east. He will be someone's problem.
<long pause>
<Elderly goblin matriarch: low female contralto, husky dry rasp and age-creak; measured, wary, quietly commanding, with tired warmth. Mood: idle.> Anything else, valley people? The fire is small, and I am old.
<long pause>
<Elderly goblin matriarch: low female contralto, husky dry rasp and age-creak; measured, wary, quietly commanding, with tired warmth. Mood: idle.> Go well. Walk loud on the path, so the archers know it is you.
